feature: Splop Tangent reference spheres: shared Circle/Arc picker, sphere-specific minimum-gap contacts, immutable sources, live great circles and preserved selection/history
native_driver: Public Rhino commands in owned empty documents at idle with private settings schemes. Physical curve/edge clicks record managed mouse-move and click acknowledgement plus projected contact positions independently of deformation outputs.
assembly: The new corpus retains the original 97 workflows in three native batches plus three minimum-gap follow-ups. Each original batch request and its offset are preserved; future generation produces the same 100-operation request.

comparisons.prior_workflow_bounds: Retained from docs/splop-guided-validation.json and its predecessor receipts; fitted geometry uses 2e-5 and separate off-grid local checks use 1.1e-6.

resolved_discrepancies: Reference guide B-reps are constructed at document modelling tolerance, rather than the degeneracy-only primitive validation policy.

Both curve orders and both sides confirm that unconstrained Splop circle/line references use minimum-gap contacts with the first contact supplying the seam. Circle retains its own fixed-last-contact rule.

Three rational-arc radius cases exceed the 1e-6 cloud bound. Their 2e-5 qualification remains explicit; the portable reference also passes the exact center (3,4,0), radius 2 and X axis (-0.6,-0.8,0) construction at 1e-9. The basis-cloud discrepancy is consistent with amplification of native approximate reference axes; that cause is an inference from the public outputs.

diagnostics.description: Six clean native pilot cases, separate from the qualified corpus.

Three direct Circle getter cases, three matching Splop cases and three minimum-gap follow-ups, with original requests, responses, frozen source hashes and driver script text. The final three follow-ups are also included in the 100-workflow corpus.

checks.name: Python request validation, source closures, staged helpers, native input and history receipts

limits: Comparisons concern sampled cloud locations, full unchanged guide controls, metadata, selection and real Undo/Redo.
Three arc-reference workflows are qualified at 2e-5 rather than document tolerance.
Viewport pixel equivalence, continuous deviation certificates and Splop performance remain unqualified.
Native-smlib verification covers the command API and strict compilation; interactive replay uses the portable build.
